ranked.headline: Learned representations couple cell-gene and spatial constraints in omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent December 2025 preprints and publications extend learned representations to spatial, single-cell, and morphological profiling data.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link genome architecture to size and evolutionary history
ranked.summary: Near-complete and chromosome-scale assemblies now resolve structural variation, repeat content and centromere organisation across diverse taxa.

ranked.headline: Methods correcting batch, segmentation and reference effects in single-cell analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend single-cell and spatial tools to batch-aware gene selection, transcript correction, and sample-level embeddings.

ranked.headline: Guidance, synthesis constraints, and foundation-model priors steer molecular design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints encode design criteria directly into generative and selection loops for protein, small-molecule, and PROTAC design.

ranked.headline: Graph and language-model learning advance drug-target interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs graph neural networks with knowledge graphs, optimal transport and language-model embeddings for scarce-label interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models link bacterial gene content to metabolic function and flux
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models now span thousands of prokaryotic genomes, linking gene content to growth, flux, and essentiality.

ranked.headline: Multiscale MD maps chemerin-CCRL2 interface and GumK substrate gating at residue level
ranked.summary: Recent multiscale simulations attribute recognition and substrate specificity to specific residues, moving beyond whole-pose scoring.

ranked.headline: Evaluating omics analysis pipelines against known reference points and benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test statistical choices in metaproteomics and spatial proteomics against known reference data.

ranked.headline: Model-based estimators recover structure from noisy single-cell and omics measurements
ranked.summary: Single-cell and omics datasets are scaling to millions of cells and require estimators with formal guarantees and calibrated uncertainty.

ranked.headline: Single-cell transcriptomics maps cell-type genetics, communication and drug response
ranked.summary: Recent items pair scRNA-seq with eQTL mapping, cell-cell communication inference and population-scale atlases to resolve cell-type-specific regulation.

ranked.headline: Non-additive and regulatory models partition genetic architecture of complex traits
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale data now allow testing dominance, epistasis and causal regulatory effects beyond marginal additive association.

ranked.headline: Latent neural representations spanning scales, modalities and recording types
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous neural recordings from fMRI, iEEG, spikes and LFP are now being modeled with latent representations that handle scale and sampling irregularity.

ranked.headline: Sampling structure and database cutoffs shape ML predictions of bacterial resistance
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications audit ML resistance and transfer predictors for sampling bias, cutoff errors, and held-out validity design.

ranked.headline: RBP binding at exon flanks links exon inclusion to histone marks
ranked.summary: Coupling RBP binding to chromatin and NMD decay readouts is emerging, with the chromatin link so far resting on one exon-usage study.

ranked.headline: Deep learning tools evaluated on disordered proteins, membrane targets, and nanobodies
ranked.summary: Predictors and ML potentials are being stress-tested on hard targets where monomer accuracy does not guarantee multimer, complex, or design reliability.

ranked.headline: Reference-benchmarked tools for nanopore RNA modification and long-read isoform analysis
ranked.summary: Benchmarks against defined reference sets now validate nanopore RNA modification and long-read transcriptome tools.

ranked.headline: Explicit quantitative models linking circuit parameters to observed neural dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs explicit parameterized models with E/I, stimulation, and fMRI measurements across network and whole-brain scales.

ranked.headline: Machine learning maps molecular and clinical features to cancer drug response
ranked.summary: Multi-omics fusion, graph embeddings, and single-cell foundation models are now benchmarked for predicting treatment response across cancer types.

ranked.headline: Graph and language-model encodings of biomolecular structure for pattern discovery
ranked.summary: Protein language models and structure-derived graphs now support identification of ion channels, lysins, and glycan-related sites from sequence and 3D data.

ranked.headline: Agentic LLMs and multimodal embeddings are being built into omics analysis workflows
ranked.summary: December 2025 preprints couple LLM agents, multimodal contrastive embeddings, and interactive visualization with omics and biomedical text data.

ranked.headline: Learned and theoretical spectral models improve identifications from raw MS data
ranked.summary: Recent work applies learned and theoretical-spectrum models directly to raw tandem and high-resolution MS data, targeting peptide, peak, and formula levels.

ranked.headline: Functional annotation and cross-disorder transfer refine GWAS locus discovery
ranked.summary: Cell-type, transformer-based, and shared-factor models are moving GWAS results toward cell-type-resolved biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Stereochemistry-aware metabolite assignment and atom provenance in reaction networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize isotopomer labeling enumeration and stereochemically aware metabolite identity assignment directly from chemical structure.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned design extends to antibodies, peptides, and small-molecule binders
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published workflow apply structure-based scoring to antibody, peptide, and binder design across binding and developability objectives.

ranked.headline: Automated and learned variant classification methods for germline and tumour-only data
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and published benchmark work targets automated, ancestry-unbiased variant classification for germline and tumour-only calls.

ranked.headline: Long-read sequencing resolves variation in human centromeres, telomeres, and rDNA
ranked.summary: Complete and nanopore long-read genomes now characterize repeat-rich chromosome ends and centromeres across populations, tissues, and pedigrees.

ranked.headline: Established indexing primitives recombined for pangenome alignment and k-mer storage
ranked.summary: Ancient DNA alignment, related-sample k-mer storage, and pangenome path enumeration each adapt indexing to a defined analytical target.

ranked.headline: Chromatin and mitotic folding models coupled to measured observables
ranked.summary: Recent mechanistic models tie chromatin folding and loop-extrusion simulations explicitly to experimental measurements rather than simulation alone.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based typing resolves bacterial strain lineages and pathogen AMR genes
ranked.summary: Sequencing-based methods now resolve bacterial strain lineages, pathogens, and resistance genes faster and at finer genomic resolution.

ranked.headline: Energy models of nucleic acid structure predict Cas9 cleavage and RNA folding under force
ranked.summary: Mechanistic free-energy and coarse-grained models now predict sequence-dependent Cas9 activity and RNA behavior under force.

ranked.headline: Haplotype blocks and 3D structure are being packaged as analysis software
ranked.summary: Recent tools operationalize haplotype-level inference from phased VCF files and 3D protein structures for evolutionary and association analyses.

ranked.headline: Omics software tools target benchmarking, genomic interval operations and data standards
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications package benchmarking, interval operations and lossless data standards for processed omics outputs.

ranked.headline: Neural parameterization of explicit mechanisms for reaction and gene regulatory dynamics
ranked.summary: Neural models are now paired with explicit mechanistic structure to infer reaction networks and single-cell regulatory dynamics from trajectory data.

ranked.headline: Biophysical models quantify conduction and spinal blood flow changes in silico
ranked.summary: Patient-specific CFD and standardized nerve-fiber simulation tools now appear alongside detailed axon models of conduction and structural damage.

ranked.headline: Assembly reliability and lifestyle shape fungal and viral genome resources
ranked.summary: Curated genome resources and quality audits now expose sampling bias and assembly reliability across fungal and viral genome collections.

ranked.headline: Noise control and propagation shape transcriptional switching and causal gene inference
ranked.summary: Simulations and theory now quantify how noise is suppressed and propagated in gene networks, enabling causal inference from static expression data.

ranked.headline: Correcting genotyping and methylation array platform effects in genomic inference
ranked.summary: Array-specific platform effects bias epigenetic clocks and GWAS mega-analyses, motivating calibration and batch correction before pooled inference.

ranked.headline: Coupled behavioral and network epidemic models with proven threshold and stability
ranked.summary: Coupling behavior, contact structure, and risk compensation into epidemic models sharpens threshold and stability predictions.

ranked.headline: Standardized feature scoring extends from bulk expression to isoforms and chromatin
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend quantitative feature evaluation from bulk gene expression to isoform-resolved and single-cell chromatin data.

ranked.headline: Genomes resolve phototrophy, marine ecotypes, and a deep-branching algal lineage
ranked.summary: Isolate and environmental genome datasets now resolve bacterial and algal lineages at ecologically meaningful levels.
